facts.fact: Presidential Decree 95/21 of 20 April 2021 merged the Angolan standardisation institute IANORQ and the accreditation institute IAAC into the National Institute of Quality Infrastructure (INIQ), a public institute whose remit includes coordinating national standardisation, developing and publishing the national body of standards and homologating Angolan standards; the document names no national standard on information technology or data.
facts.system: Instituto Nacional das Infra-Estruturas da Qualidade (INIQ)

systems.system: Instituto Nacional das Infra-Estruturas da Qualidade (INIQ)
systems.owner: Ministry responsible for industry and commerce (superintendence)

systems.system: Sistema Nacional de Gestão de Regulamentos Técnicos (SINGERT)

note: INIQ is a public certification and accreditation body for conformity generally, but the decree names no IT or data standard and no certification against one, so no certification fact; technical-regulation platform SINGERT is other.
